description: Fetch the people who list a company as their employer, 25 a page from Sales Navigator, which hides no one: each person's name, location and profile, and their current roles, each with its title, employer and `company_id`, and start month. The same object, and price, as linkedin/people with `source=sales_navigator`. Takes the company's numeric id, `company_id` in linkedin/company. Use this to map a company's team or to find who to contact. Costs 170 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

company_id.description: LinkedIn's numeric id for the company: `company_id` in linkedin/company.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

name: get_linkedin_company_people
title: Get the people at a company, from LinkedIn
